name: Cactus
tagline: Cactus, Inc. designs, manufactures, and services wellhead systems, pressure control equipment, and spoolable pipe solutions for onshore oil and gas operations.
hero_kpi_rationale: Le segment Contrôle de Pression représente 78% des revenus totaux et demeure le principal moteur de l'activité de l'entreprise malgré une baisse de 0,9% année sur année due à la volatilité des prix du pétrole.

kpis.explanation: Revenues from the sale, rental and field services of wellhead and pressure control equipment for oil and gas drilling, completion and production operations.
kpis.signal: Revenue stability despite oil market decline; maintains market position in wellhead systems.
kpis.description: This segment comprises the sale and rental of wellhead and pressure control equipment, essential for drilling, completion and production phases. Products sold under the Cactus Wellhead brand serve onshore unconventional oil and gas wells.
kpis.explanation_en: Revenue from the Pressure Control Segment segment.

kpis.explanation: Revenues from the sale and rental of spoolable pipe and associated fittings for hydrocarbon transportation and field services.
kpis.signal: Strong growth driven by increased adoption of rapid production solutions and natural gas infrastructure expansion.
kpis.description: This segment focuses on FlexSteel products used as production, gathering and takeaway pipelines. Growth reflects increased demand from well placement into production post-completion.
kpis.explanation_en: Revenue from the Spoolable Technologies Segment segment.

kpis.explanation: Ratio of gross profit to total revenue, expressed as a percentage, reflecting production efficiency and cost management.
kpis.signal: Improving profitability through cost reduction initiatives and pricing increases offsetting tariff and input cost pressures.
kpis.description: Gross margin reflects the efficiency of production and cost of goods sold management, improved by operational efficiency gains and partial mitigation of tariff impacts.
kpis.explanation_en: Gross Margin, gross profit divided by revenue.

kpis.explanation: Consolidated revenue from all operating segments, comprising product sales, equipment rentals, and field services.
kpis.signal: Modest revenue growth driven by Spoolable Technologies segment despite 6% decline in average U.S. drilling rigs.
kpis.description: Total revenue represents consolidated sales of products, rentals and services from both Pressure Control and Spoolable Technologies segments.

kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue allocated to research and development activities for product innovation and improvement.
kpis.signal: Stable R&D investment indicating focus on continuous product improvement within existing technology platforms.
kpis.description: R&D expenditures are critical for innovation and competitive advantage in oilfield equipment manufacturing.
kpis.explanation_en: Revenue from the R&D as % segment.

kpis.explanation: Expenditures for acquisition or improvement of long-term physical assets including manufacturing facilities and service infrastructure.
kpis.signal: Significant capital investment to support production capacity expansion and service center infrastructure development.
kpis.description: Capex indicates investments in manufacturing facilities (Bossier City, Baytown, Suzhou, Hai Duong), service centers and equipment to support future growth.

ai_positioning.summary: The company acknowledges artificial intelligence infrastructure build-out as a positive driver of natural gas demand, which strengthened medium-to-long term natural gas price outlook and supported industry activity levels in 2025.
evidence: Optimism regarding the medium-to-long term outlook for natural gas demand strengthened as energy demands from artificial intelligence-associated infrastructure build out increased. Henry Hub natural gas prices increased approximately 61% in 2025.
ai_positioning.source: Item 7. Management Discussion and Analysis, Recent Developments and Trends section

risks.title: Oil Price Volatility
risks.score_rationale: Oil prices declined 15% in 2025 from 2024 levels; average WTI fell from $76.63 to $65.39 per barrel, reducing U.S. drilling rig activity by 6% and impacting product demand (Item 7, MD&A Recent Developments)
risks.summary: Oil price volatility directly impacts drilling activity levels and product demand for wellhead and pressure control equipment

risks.title: Geopolitical Conflicts
risks.score_rationale: Ongoing conflicts in Ukraine and Middle East have global repercussions on commodity prices, increased market uncertainty and volatile equity and commodity pricing (Item 7, MD&A)
risks.summary: Geopolitical tensions create market volatility affecting oil prices and customer investment decisions

risks.title: Tariffs and Trade Policies
risks.score_rationale: Section 232 tariffs of 50% on steel imports and Synthetic Opioid tariffs on China imports have elevated costs on Vietnam and China imports; tariff impacts on profitability partially mitigated by cost reduction and pricing (Item 7, MD&A)
risks.summary: U.S. trade policy changes increase input costs and manufacturing expenses, impacting profitability

risks.title: Decline in Oil-Directed Drilling Activity
risks.score_rationale: Weaker oil demand and increased supply outlook led to 6% decline in average U.S. land drilling rigs in 2025; further decline expected in 2026 which will reduce domestic product and service demand (Item 7, MD&A)
risks.summary: Reduced drilling activity directly decreases demand for wellhead systems and completion equipment

risks.title: International Tax Framework (Pillar Two)
risks.score_rationale: OECD Pillar Two implementing 15% global minimum tax on multinational corporations; company estimates impact to income tax expense will be immaterial pending side-by-side solution implementation (Item 7, MD&A)
risks.summary: International minimum tax framework may affect effective tax rate, though current impact assessed as immaterial

risks.title: Steel Input Cost Inflation
risks.score_rationale: Section 232 tariffs resulted in generally higher steel input costs at Bossier City manufacturing facility; impact partially mitigated by cost reduction efforts and increased pricing (Item 7, MD&A)
risks.summary: Rising steel costs increase manufacturing expenses and compress margins if pricing adjustments are insufficient

risks.title: Industry Cyclicality and Demand Dependency
risks.score_rationale: Company revenue highly dependent on oil and gas industry activity levels including active drilling rigs, new wells drilled, completions and production volumes; demand historically volatile (Item 7, MD&A)
risks.summary: Business is inherently cyclical and vulnerable to fluctuations in oil and gas industry capital spending

governance.voting_structure: Holders of Class A and Class B common stock vote together as a single class on each proposal, with each share entitling the holder to one vote.
